name: thread-hijack-name-reuse
description: The same attack without a lookalike domain: the attacker keeps the display name of a participant already in the thread and sends from an unrelated consumer mailbox, relying on the mail client showing the name and hiding the address. No domain here resembles any other, so the lookalike rule cannot fire and only the name-reuse rule can. Sender name identical to a prior participant, address on a freemail domain, and a Reply-To pointing somewhere else again.
